arithmetic_contract: Reuse the per-K16 native/reference group envelope, including signed cancellation, subnormal floors and final scale rounding. All captured scores and generated finite controls are checked against it; observed error/bound ratios are not calibration coefficients.

Repair every interval that may attain a K32 prefix maximum, including ties. Repair probability intervals whose BF16 endpoints differ. Selection and replay read original Q/K only, never the full exact-score comparison buffer.

Propagate probability endpoints through the original positive butterfly and denominator recurrence. Reciprocal intervals account for the validated table delta range; equal denominator endpoints use the exact lookup.
An unresolved output selects a contributor refinement pass using a fixed work threshold. The output interval is checked again, and remaining uncertain rows replay every remaining score.
Every candidate numerator uses canonical PV in this component. Baseline output only enters diagnostic comparisons; it never selects a score or a row.
decision: Keep the complete denominator-refinement route outside product dispatch: it preserves every GB10 BF16 context cell but replays403235056 of411213840 scores. Contributor refinement dominates. Next isolate the already exact probability/alpha path with its approximate denominator for an explicit GB10 product trial; this potential floating change receives no correctness acceptance before that trial.
limitations: No model is loaded, no tokens are generated, and no real callback TTFT is measured. The product stack remains whole4fec3ea / CK126cdcb / FLA-MoE8f / CLIa797 with direct PV enabled.
The candidate uses canonical PV for every output; its component wall is not the deployed native-PV-plus-replay path.

Reported pipeline time includes completion fences and diagnostic output-certificate comparisons, but excludes shared uploads, allocation, baseline validation and host statistic downloads. It is not a pure kernel or product benchmark.
Whole-allocation redzones and immutable inputs pass; per-slab tail redzones are not established.
The strict fallback component is correct on the declared captures. Its bounds remain subject to independent native and full GB10 product validation on any runtime integration.
Retained performance, long-context, checkpoint, package, HTTP, soak and release gates remain open.
